svg.title: FG-C1: Equal outputs: intersections
svg.desc: Teal is f; amber is g. A later stage turns their signed difference into a graph. Static design sketch showing two selected states. Read the learning plan for the full interaction.
svg.text: ANNOTATED DESIGN SKETCH · selected states, not a production screen
Move x until f(x) and g(x) agree.
At x=1, the outputs are 0 and 2.
Read both coordinates of the shared point.
The input is 2; the intersection is (2,3).
Teal is f; amber is g. A later stage turns their signed difference into a graph.
